topics.title: How to Respect Government Properties (Primary 1)
topics.content:
CIVIC EDUCATION
RELIGION AND NATIONAL VALUE
FIRST TERM
WEEK 6
PRIMARY 1
THEME -
PREVIOUS LESSON - WAYS OF RESPECTING PLACES AND THINGS
TOPIC - HOW TO RESPECT GOVERNMENT PROPERTIES
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, the pupils should have attained the following objectives (cognitive, affective and psychomotor) and should be able to -
- mention those properties that belong to the government.
- identify the chairs in their classes, school library, playing gadgets, books, flag as government properties.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of:
- Pictures and charts showing government properties.
- Charts showing how to maintain such properties.
METHOD OF TEACHING - Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
- Scheme of Work
- 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
- Course Book
- All Relevant Material
- Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
ACTIVITIES - IDENTIFICATION OF GOVERNMENT PROPERTIES
- Building
- Library
- Road
- Pipe born water
- Schools
- Healthcare, etc.
HOW TO RESPECT GOVERNMENT PROPERTIES
Maintaining government properties, e.g.
- Building
- Library
- Road
- Pope born water,
- Health care center, etc.
PRESENTATION
- To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
- To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
- Leads pupils to identify government properties.
- Pupil’s Activities - Participate in identifying government property.
- Teaches them how to maintain government properties.
- Pupil’s Activities - Listen and discover how to maintain government properties.
CONCLUSION
- To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
- Next Lesson - Reasons for Respecting Elders I
LESSON EVALUATION
Pupils to:
- mention those things that belong to the government.
- mention two ways we can maintain these properties mentions.
